presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The three fabrics take a warm ladder and the paper goes tan, which reads like a quilt photographed decades ago.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Three greys, no hue at all.
presets.description: The block geometry carries the picture on its own, which makes this style one of the few where a greyscale set loses almost nothing.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: Background and all three fabrics take the same hue at different lightnesses.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style ships strong reds, greens and golds. This trades them for dusty tones, which moves the quilt from folk art towards linen.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: colors past anything the style ships, on a dark ground so the quilt reads as lit.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The whole quilt drops to pastels, which suits a nursery or an onboarding screen better than the default folk palette.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: Three flat primaries and nothing between them. The block geometry is strong enough to carry a palette this blunt.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in on a couple of blocks.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. Two large blocks read better at avatar size than a full quilt of small ones.
